scope: S600 single-press service fixture with electrical R6.3/R6.6/R9.9 and 10 pF per control net
interpretation: Both 25 ns and 12.5 ns runs completed but emitted the same Icarus Shim VPI time reversal, from 0.001394028607 to 0.001394028208 seconds. Neither qualifies. A focused 0.25 ns startup diagnostic instead aborts at about 34.236 us with a timestep-too-small error at sdata. No acceptance threshold or diagnostic filter was relaxed.

bridgeDiagnostic.scope: Logging-only separate VPI library, 1.394–1.395 ms window
bridgeDiagnostic.observation: After logic_control=110 input and data/LED output callbacks at HDL time 0.001394028607 s, the next requested time is 0.0013940282079924105 s. The shortened run reproduces the original reversal and reaches 1.5 ms. This locates the bridge boundary failure but does not establish its root cause.
